dataset_metadata.description: FineWeb-Edu is a subset of the FineWeb dataset, consisting of 1.3 trillion tokens of English web pages. It was filtered using a Llama-3-70B-Instruct classifier trained to identify educational value. The dataset is designed to provide high-quality pre-training data by retaining only content with high educational scores (3 or higher on a 1-5 scale).

schema_analysis.description: The raw text content of the web page after extraction and cleaning.

structural_logic.relationships: The 'text' column contains the primary data, while 'score' acts as the primary filter criterion. 'id' links the processed text back to its 'url' and 'dump' metadata.
structural_logic.label_dynamics: The dataset is filtered to only include instances with a 'score' >= 3, creating a distribution skewed heavily toward high-quality educational content rather than a representative web sample.
structural_logic.potential_bottlenecks: Model-based filtering may introduce systematic biases inherent to the Llama-3 classifier; web-crawled text may still contain artifacts like navigation menus or boilerplates despite cleaning.
